# TODAY on a date field
due = TODAY

# The current week, Monday to Sunday
due >= START_OF_WEEK AND due <= END_OF_WEEK

# The current month
due >= START_OF_MONTH AND due <= END_OF_MONTH

# The current year
due >= START_OF_YEAR AND due <= END_OF_YEAR

# Business days skip the weekend: Tuesday + 3 is Friday
due = {TODAY + 3::BUSINESS_DAYS}

# ... and Tuesday + 5 is the next Tuesday
due = {TODAY + 5::BUSINESS_DAYS}

# NOW minus minutes on a timestamp field
last_seen > {NOW - 30::MINUTES}

# NOW minus hours
last_seen > {NOW - 2::HOURS}

# TODAY on a timestamp field is the whole day
last_seen = TODAY

# != TODAY on a timestamp field keeps NULL rows
last_seen != TODAY

# >= a date on a timestamp field starts at midnight
last_seen >= START_OF_WEEK

# <= a date on a timestamp field includes that whole day: Eve at 23:59:59
last_seen <= {TODAY - 1::DAYS}

# The current month on a timestamp field
last_seen >= START_OF_MONTH AND last_seen <= END_OF_MONTH

# < START_OF_YEAR on a timestamp field
last_seen < START_OF_YEAR

# DAYS on a timestamp field
created_at >= {TODAY - 7::DAYS}

# NOW minus an hour
created_at > {NOW - 1::HOURS}

# A relative value on a lateral field
last_order_at > {NOW - 1::HOURS}

# Keywords are case-insensitive
due = today
